article.title: Elipsis
article.chapter: Modelo de campos y sintaxis C1–C2 — Feldermodell und Syntax C1–C2

claims.sectionKey: La elipsis consiste en omitir una parte de la estructura porque puede recuperarse con claridad a partir del contexto.
claims.summary: The elipsis involves omitting a part of the structure that can be clearly recovered from the context.

claims.sectionKey: En coordinaciones, la elipsis es especialmente frecuente cuando dos segmentos comparten material.
claims.summary: Coordinations often feature elipsis when two segments share material.

claims.sectionKey: En respuestas: Wer kommt morgen? – Paul.
claims.summary: In responses, elipsis appears as in the example 'Wer kommt morgen? – Paul.'

claims.sectionKey: La recuperabilidad depende de la sintaxis y del discurso.
claims.summary: The recoverability of elipsis depends on syntax and discourse.

claims.sectionKey: En análisis avanzados se distinguen diferentes tipos de elipsis, por ejemplo elipsis en coordinación, respuestas fragmentarias o estructuras donde queda un rema
claims.summary: Advanced analysis distinguishes different types of elipsis, including coordination, fragmentary responses, and structures with a contrasting residue.

links.notes: The claim is directly supported by the definition of elipsis provided in the article, which is sourced from the Leibniz-Institut für Deutsche Sprache's entry on Anaphoric elipsis.
The article provides an example of elipsis in coordination (Ich trinke Kaffee und Anna Tee), which is sourced from the same authoritative entry on Anaphoric elipsis.
The article includes the example 'Wer kommt morgen? – Paul.' as a demonstration of elipsis in responses, sourced from the same authoritative entry.
The article explicitly states that the recoverability of elipsis depends on syntax and discourse, which is supported by the authoritative source on Anaphoric elipsis.
The article mentions advanced distinctions of elipsis types, which aligns with the detailed explanation provided in the authoritative source on Anaphoric elipsis.
